0022600209.text: The Phoenix Suns (3-5, 3rd in the Pacific, 12th in the West) host the San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest, 3rd in the West), with Phoenix riding a two-game win streak and holding a 3-2 home record while San Antonio enters on an eight-game winning streak and a 4-0 road record. Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) and is monitoring Devin Vassell (groin), who is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on March 19, 2026, in San Antonio, a 101-100 Suns loss.
